component.name: Beamer
component.summary: Share one keyboard and mouse between your computers

description.p: Beamer shares your keyboard, mouse and clipboard between paired computers on your network. Move through a screen edge to control another computer.

On Linux, Beamer uses the desktop's input capture, remote desktop and clipboard portals on Wayland, or X11. Wayland support depends on the portals your desktop provides. Crossing effects are unavailable on Wayland.
